The wait between the first two seasons of "Severance" has already been quite long, and the third season is equally testing of patience—but Apple TV+ has just announced a major update on the show's progress.

"Severance" Season 3 has officially begun filming and is expected to premiere in late 2027

It has been roughly 18 months since Season 2 of "Severance" aired. Although the progress of Season 3 has not been ideal, it has just reached an important milestone.

According to Ben Stiller's latest post on X (also reposted by the official Apple TV account), Season 3 of "Severance" has officially entered production.

The low-resolution production photo shared by Stiller appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running down a Lumon hallway, echoing the closing scene of Season 2.

At the end of Season 2, Mark made a shocking decision—to stay by Helly's side, opposing their "outies" together, abandoning his original plan to reunite with Gemma—setting up a string of gripping storylines for Season 3.

There was a three-year gap between Seasons 1 and 2 of "Severance," due to script revisions, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes, among other issues.

If the production period for Season 3 is six to nine months, plus roughly half a year of post-production, viewers will most likely see the return of "Severance" in autumn 2027—just a few months shorter than the three-year hiatus.

When do you expect Season 3 of "Severance" to premiere? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, with discounts available when bundled through Apple One.
